climate-energy.heading: Make Big Tech Pay Its Own Way
climate-energy.quote: Push for a pause on new data center construction until the companies agree to pay for their own power and water, show the deal before it is signed, and hire Mississippi workers in writing
climate-energy.note: This passage is about data centers raising power bills. We found no passage about climate change.

priorities.heading: Supporting Our 2nd Amendment Rights
priorities.quote: She will always stand up for our 2nd Amendment Constitutional rights.

priorities.heading: Balancing the Budget
priorities.quote: As your U.S. Senator, nobody will work harder to pass a Balanced Budget Amendment to the U.S. Constitution.

priorities.heading: Health Care
priorities.quote: Cindy believes the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act, better known as Obamacare, should be repealed and replaced with a common-sense, patient-centered healthcare plan to help Mississippi families afford health insurance coverage without expanding the government’s role in providing health care.

cost-of-living.heading: More Jobs
cost-of-living.quote: To keep our economy growing, Cindy will work with her colleagues and President Trump to roll back unnecessary rules and regulations that hinder job creation and stymie economic growth.

health-care.heading: Health Care

immigration.heading: Stopping Illegal Immigration
immigration.quote: She believes illegal immigration must come to an end and supports President Trump’s plans to build a wall on America’s southwestern border and to increase funding to enforce U.S. immigration laws.

foreign-policy.heading: Israel
foreign-policy.quote: Cindy supports President Trump’s decision to locate the American embassy in Jerusalem and will work to strengthen U.S.-Israeli national security, economic and cultural interests.

priorities.heading: Jobs & Economy
priorities.quote: As your next Senator, I’ll focus on bringing good-paying jobs to every corner of Mississippi—especially the areas that have been left behind.

priorities.heading: Healthcare
priorities.quote: I believe healthcare is a fundamental human right—not a privilege based on your job, your ZIP code, or your luck. That’s why I support the Medicare for All Act—because it’s time we guarantee every American access to high-quality, affordable healthcare, no matter where they live or what they earn.

priorities.heading: Housing
priorities.quote: Support new construction, infill development, and the rehabilitation of older homes—so that more people will be encouraged to move to Mississippi or return home to take advantage of our state’s affordability.
